description: Get a single story in the lean camelCase shape (heavy text — description, acceptance criteria, test plan, hypothesis, hidden unknowns — omitted by default; opt back in via include, e.g. include:["description","acceptanceCriteria"] to read the full story text). Accepts the full UUID, the readable ID you see on cards/links (e.g. INDTEK-494), or an unambiguous UUID prefix (e.g. the 8-char short hash) — no need for a list_stories round-trip. Resolution is workspace-scoped; an ambiguous prefix returns a clear error.

id.description: Story reference: a full UUID, a readable ID (INDTEK-494), or an unambiguous UUID prefix (8+ chars).

include.description: Heavy fields to opt back into the default shape — e.g. include:["description","acceptanceCriteria"] to read the full story text before implementing, or ["attachmentExcerpts"] for attached-file excerpts (Tier-0 attachment metadata always rides along). Ignored when view:"summary".

view.description: summary → minimal { id, title, points, state, workflowStage, lane, epicId, reviewStatus }. Omit (or "full") for the default lean shape (camelCase-only, heavy text omitted).

name: get_story
